description: Elections Commission - Declare that T. M. Somawathie as a member of the Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member to fill the vacant seat, which falls directly under electoral processes and matters related to local government elections.
